newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes slightly firmer, stays quiet.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes slightly firmer, stays quiet.

text.p: GOLD - Quiet and steady. Fixed at $319.75, up $0.75 from AM. New York opened lower in line with easier European/Asian markets then bounced. Seen lower medium term. SILVER - Firmer with gold at $4.33/$4.35 up four cents. Recovering from sell-out after failing on upside Monday. PLATINUM - Barely changed so far at $403.50/$407.50, off $2.00. PALLADIUM - Up $6.50 at $172.00/$176.00. Still tight.
